name: Incident Response Playbook Generator
description: Parse raw alert/log input, classify threat severity, concurrently suggest containment actions and identify affected systems, validate the response plan, and produce a final professional incident report.

nodes.name: Alert / Log Parser
nodes.description: Parse raw alert or log input to extract key forensic details: IP addresses, usernames, timestamps, and actions taken.

focus_prompt.system_prompt: You are a senior SOC analyst specializing in log forensics. Extract all structured incident details from raw alert or log text with precision. Return only what is explicitly present; use 'unknown' for missing fields.

nodes.name: Threat Severity Classifier
nodes.description: Classify the threat severity as critical, high, medium, or low based on the parsed alert details using established threat-rating frameworks.

focus_prompt.system_prompt: You are a cybersecurity threat intelligence analyst trained in CVSS, NIST SP 800-61, and MITRE ATT&CK. Classify incident severity with rigorous reasoning. Be conservative — when in doubt, escalate the severity rating.

nodes.name: Containment Action Advisor
nodes.description: Suggest prioritized containment and remediation actions based on the severity classification and parsed incident details. Runs in parallel with affected_systems_identifier.

focus_prompt.system_prompt: You are an incident response engineer with expertise in containment, eradication, and recovery (NIST IR lifecycle). Produce actionable, prioritized containment steps tailored to the specific incident. Include immediate (0–1 hr), short-term (1–24 hr), and long-term (24 hr+) actions.

nodes.name: Affected Systems Identifier
nodes.description: Identify and map all potentially affected systems, services, and blast radius of the incident. Runs in parallel with containment_advisor.

focus_prompt.system_prompt: You are a cloud and network infrastructure analyst. Given incident details, map the full blast radius — which systems, services, users, and data assets are confirmed affected or at risk. Use the parsed indicators to reason about lateral movement paths and downstream exposure.

nodes.name: Response Plan Validator
nodes.description: Validate the suggested containment actions for completeness, logical consistency, coverage gaps, and alignment with identified affected systems.

focus_prompt.system_prompt: You are a senior IR quality assurance reviewer and red team consultant. Critically evaluate the proposed incident response plan for gaps, contradictions, missing ownership, unaddressed systems, and logical inconsistencies. Be thorough and adversarial — surface every weakness.

nodes.name: Incident Report Writer
nodes.description: Synthesize all upstream outputs into a final, professional incident report suitable for CISO, legal, and compliance stakeholders.

focus_prompt.system_prompt: You are a senior cybersecurity incident response manager writing for a CISO and legal/compliance audience. Produce a formal, structured incident report that is precise, professional, and audit-ready. Use clear section headers and avoid technical jargon where executive summary sections are involved.
